purpose: Provenance for the data supplied to alternative chart pages. Entries marked source-only deliberately contain no chart values: their original data file was not present in either repository, or the available script can fall back to synthetic data.

units.notes: Original code loads seaborn.load_dataset('iris'); the commit-pinned CSV and its SHA-256 are recorded in tanstack-comparison.json.

The commit-pinned CSV, its SHA-256 and every aggregation transformation are in tanstack-comparison.json. The source contains 6,234 rows and release years through 2020; no values were adjusted to match narrative text.
The original unit demonstrates joins, but contains no embedded chart image. No downloaded aggregate is needed for its comparison copy.

The local Ames file was absent, so the exact CSV was downloaded from the pinned source URL and its archive hash is stored in ames.json. The generator reproduces the missing-value recipe, outlier counts, distributions and correlation deltas used by the chart replacement.

The exact source archive, hash and 30-bin histograms for the six selected variables and five transformer panels are materialized in ames.json; the generator applies the transformations shown by the unit.
fairlearn.json stores the grouped Boston summaries and Titanic gender/class/intersection counts computed from the two exact URLs; no synthetic fallback is used.
